operation_details.item: The user uses Alteryx for data preparation.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: For the operations improvement engagement, which tools are part of your current workflow?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: I use Excel for financial models.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: That gives us a practical base for the financial work. How do you handle analyses that need more customization than a spreadsheet provides?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: I use Python for custom analytics.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: A combination of spreadsheet modeling and custom analytics can support both stakeholder review and specialized analysis. What do you use for preparing and reshaping source data?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: I use Alteryx for data preparation.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: That can help make repeatable preparation steps visible before the analysis begins. Where do you keep the working materials for an engagement?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: I store all analysis files in the engagement drive.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Keeping the analysis files in one engagement location should make version coordination easier. We can map the workflow from source preparation through modeling and final outputs.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: That workflow would help clarify which steps are repeatable and which require judgment.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Exactly. We can document the handoffs and identify opportunities to improve consistency without forcing every step into the same tool.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: I can use that approach to organize the next workstream review.
